purpose: Implement one explicit bidirectional Song↔workspace reconciliation contract over canonical Technical Twin evidence and CURRENT DAW-00D Host Shadow so legitimate disagreement is surfaced, provenance is snapshotted and bounded user choices can be recorded without silently mutating either side.

lineage.outcome: When verified DAW state differs from canonical Song technical memory, N0TE shows the difference and preserves an explicit decision receipt instead of silently overwriting artist changes or canonical intent.
lineage.capability: Bidirectional Song↔workspace difference detection and explicit reconciliation decision ledger

legacy_rejections: decision receipt treated as execution receipt

completion_proof: matching canonical technical and host facts return MATCH and do not open a case
HOST_ONLY, SONG_ONLY, CONFLICT and internally unresolved canonical evidence remain distinct outcomes
comparison requires CURRENT Host Shadow and exact workspace/Song ownership
cases snapshot canonical claim IDs/values and exact Host Shadow baseline/latest batch plus host fact provenance
UPDATE_SONG, RESTORE_HOST, KEEP_WORKSPACE_SPECIFIC and DO_NOTHING are append-only decision intents only
UPDATE_SONG requires snapped host truth and RESTORE_HOST requires exactly one snapped canonical technical value
recording UPDATE_SONG creates no evidence claim and recording RESTORE_HOST creates no Host Shadow batch/event
canonical claim-set change, Host Shadow latest/baseline change or Host Shadow becoming STALE makes the case STALE
stale cases refuse new decisions until reopened from fresh evidence
DECIDED cases remain visible as pending because choice is not execution/verification
comparison reads are write-free, cases/decisions are SQL immutable, Activity records case and decision receipts, restart preserves them
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00E evidence, globally compare feature/environment registry, Musical IR/portability, any universal reconciliation execution-receipt prerequisite, remaining PLATFORM-00 and CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not remain on reconciliation by adjacency and do not select a named DAW adapter by historical maturity.
